title: mentha × rubra var. pratensis
intro: Mentha × rubra var. pratensis, commonly known as Red Mint or Red-stemmed Mint, is a hybrid species of mint that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This perennial herb is prized for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating symptoms of nausea and headaches. The therapeutic actions of Red Mint are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Mentha × rubra var. pratensis include menthone, menthyl acetate, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal and aromatic properties.
